name: power
description: Having the ability or position to shape the shared environment more than others.

variations.name: social power
variations.description: Also known as 'politics', this is having the authority to decide who's right, who's wrong, and what the group should value.

variations.name: physical power
variations.description: Being able to shape the physical environment for the benefit of you or your social group.

variations.name: mental power
variations.description: Having the ability to resolve problems in the abstract world of ideas.

commentaries.quote: With great power comes great responsibility.
Politics is the set of values for how individuals relate to the patchworked social body as a whole: what rights and responsibilities different types of people have, how rules are made and enforced.

On physical power: if you've never chopped down a tree or dug a big hole, it may be hard for you to understand why our ancestors valued physical strength so much. It's difficult work and we humans really like our wood and our holes.

On mental power: if you've never balanced a spreadsheet, your new business is likely to fail. If you've never solved an equation, your bridge is probably going to collapse. Ideas are important in shaping a complex environment.

[The founders of the United States] were insightful students of human nature. They feared the abuse of power because they understood that every human being has not only 'better angels' in his nature, but also an innate vulnerability to temptation — especially the temptation to abuse power over others.
commentaries.attribution: Al Gore, Address at New York University 2004)

commentaries.quote: Nothing discloses real character like the use of power. It is easy for the weak to be gentle. Most people can bear adversity. But if you wish to know what a man really is, give him power. This is the supreme test. It is the glory of Lincoln that, having almost absolute power, he never abused it, except on the side of mercy.
It's good to be the king.

conditions: You have the sense that you're better positioned to shape the idea environment more than others.
You have the sense that you're better positioned to shape the social environment more than others.
You have the sense that you're better positioned to shape the physical environment more than others.
